scope: physical model/data specification, not executable policy approval or a numerical test protocol
roadmap_control: Source user-approved development-order/resource amendments permit early supporting development; unchanged formal gates and native canonical data metadata govern qualification. Neither roadmap is silently reconciled.

status_semantics.READY: requires reviewed actual policy/data files, source hashes, complete physical domains, production mapping and predecessor evidence; no boolean self-approval
status_semantics.BLOCKED_MISSING_DATA: formal execution/scoring SKIPPED, not PASS; local scalar or mechanical results remain separately reportable
status_semantics.ERROR: corrupt/mismatched files, schema, implementation or execution
status_semantics.FAIL: declared supported criterion was actually evaluated and not met

COMMON-TIME-INITIAL-QUALIFICATION.description: First physical qualification uses a common advancing ensemble time and explicitly qualified common initial condition; local variable-time mechanics remain separate supporting scope.

SCALAR-PRESCRIBED-MAXWELLIAN.description: Explicit scalar electron density and temperature with native Voronov Maxwellian coefficients; this does not select a joint collision-conditioned kinetic distribution or waive measured-forcing prerequisites.

CONSERVATIVE-PACKETS-AND-MOVERS.description: Complete stoichiometric packets, exact nucleus/charge identities, represented-number conservation, remaining physical time, qualified forces and fresh daughter clocks; no redraw/drop on capacity retry.

UNSUPPORTED-CHANNELS-OFF.description: Do not activate a requested physical family while required channels/states are unsupported; do not remove hazards or renormalize the remaining branches.

PHYSICAL-MASS-INTERNAL-ENERGY.description: A single physical isotope/state mass, threshold, energy-zero and signed bath convention; material rest-mass sums are not a conserved invariant. A reference-mass plus formation/excitation-energy implementation requires a proved approximation bound and explicit code mapping.

INITIAL-AND-PRODUCT-STATES.description: Authoritative isotope/electronic/fine/rovibrational initial populations and state-resolved outgoing populations for every supported channel. OH_exp is compilation provenance, not a state.

PHOTON-SPECTRUM-GEOMETRY-POLARIZATION.description: Solar spectral photon flux, exact averaging convention, incoming direction/disc and polarization state, frame/time, partial cross sections, threshold interpretation and shadow exposure. Preserve quiet/active endpoints separately.

ATOMIC-PHOTO-KINEMATICS.description: Photon-conditioned electron/residual-ion state and joint energy/direction; include photon momentum and independently specified bath exchanges.

MOLECULAR-JOINT-KINEMATICS.description: All seven H2O and four OH_exp channel joint product states, correlated energies and directions over declared photon/initial-state domains, with no mean-energy delta/isotropic substitution.

EXCITED-STATE-DECAY-QUENCHING.description: Complete O(1S)/O(1D) radiative branches, state energies and any required OH relaxation/predissociation or independently bounded omissions; no forced all-ground or unit cascade.

ELECTRON-RESERVOIR-VS-PIC.description: Recommend an explicitly prescribed electron reservoir for the initial exosphere scope; full PIC electrons/self-consistent fields are not enabled by scalar Maxwellian approval. Reservoir particle/charge/momentum/energy exchange must be predicted from the sampled physical event.

ELECTRON-COLLISION-JOINT-KINETICS.description: Collision-conditioned incoming electron and both outgoing electrons/ion states; differential-source normalization consistent with the approved total Maxwellian coefficient, including support/tails.

CEX-PROJECTILE-DISTRIBUTION-SUPPORT.description: Explicit projectile species/state, density and beam/distribution; target-rest eV/u convention, collision-biased sampling and supported integration/tail policy.

CEX-JOINT-STATE-RECOIL.description: All captured H states/residual-ion states, state-specific Q and correlated deflection/recoil distribution; total capture and independent marginal tables alone do not determine this.

ION-SURFACE-OUTCOME.description: Material/charge/energy/incidence/temperature-specific joint reflection, neutralization, implantation, charge transfer, sputtering and release with complete surface ledgers.

H2O-OH-SURFACE-MIGRATION.description: Species/state/material dependent sticking, site-energy/residence, release/re-emission, migration and photochemistry with H/O inventory; literal U24 is not replaced by a gas-only kernel.

MEASURED-EVENT-FORCING.description: Explicit independent event/spacecraft selection, electron moments/distributions and uncertainties, native time/frame/quality/gaps and source-to-Moon mapping; R4.1/D06 required for the measured-event branch.

physical_conventions.bath_exchange_sign: signed change of untracked environment per physical event; tracked change + bath change closes total physical energy/momentum/charge/nuclei
physical_conventions.rest_mass_conservation: sum of material rest masses is not conserved; energy defects belong in total energy, not an invented compensating bath species/mass

retained_dependencies.U24: literal full H2O/OH migration+surface+chemistry contract remains; gas-only molecular tests do not PASS it
retained_dependencies.I23: prescribed scalar/local checks do not waive R4.1/D06 measured-event requirements; no electron moments inferred from bulk ion moments
retained_dependencies.formal_predecessors: same-campaign M1/M2 and all existing per-test U/I predecessors remain; parent numerical protocol separately binds actual evidence

available_data_qualification.rates_and_schema_only: extraction QA and source hashes do not qualify physical product kinetics

current_implementation_limitations: Current constant-history native mechanics use nominal neutral/ion equal masses and zero-Q controls, not physical photon/electron/CEX laws.

ReactionExecution explicitly verifies declared additive model-mass/classical-energy closure; a physical rest-mass/formation-energy convention and implementation mapping must be reviewed before enabling physical channels.
Current combined controller accepts constant-history hazards only; it cannot freeze a physical trajectory/illumination-dependent hazard.
A policy.qualified boolean or source/evidence identity string alone is not independent scientific qualification.
Current M2 Na/Ar neutral surface kernels do not establish any ion-surface or water/OH law.
